features: Real-time progress updates via Supabase Realtime
Visual progress bar with percentage display
Job status indicators (pending, processing, completed, failed)
ARIA live region for screen reader announcements
notes: Component subscribes to Supabase Realtime channels for job updates
Progress bar color changes based on job status
onComplete and onError callbacks provided for parent component integration
Proper cleanup prevents memory leaks with channel unsubscribe
Status displayed with appropriate icons (Clock, Loader, CheckCircle, AlertCircle)
Accessibility ensured with proper ARIA attributes and live regions
